resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says constructed in 1921; the 1922-23 annual report, as quoted by Forest Lookouts, says erected in 1922 and opened April 1. Not reconciled. The story gives both and does not choose.

The 1966 bid notice calls for relocating the tower and erecting a 40-ft extension. The register records a 40-ft section added in the 1930s and mentions no move. Whether these are the same work is unclear, and the notice does not confirm the move was done.

notes_for_editor: Access level 'restricted' is an inference from active agency service; no source states a public visiting rule. No current staffing data was found, so no staffing fact is recorded. The 1966 item is a bid notice, so relocation is unconfirmed. The brief had no build date; 1921 comes from the register and 1922 from the annual report as quoted. The NJ DEP fire-tower page returned no text from the cache and was not used.
